purpose: Add a terrain-context block to the frozen Pygoscelis site atlas without opening demographic outcomes.

source_sites.candidate_gate: at least 5 distinct nest-count years spanning at least 10 years
source_sites.outcome_blind_constraint: Population trend direction, abundance change, extinction, colonization and replacement outcomes remain unopened.

rema.dataset: Reference Elevation Model of Antarctica (REMA) mosaic
rema.source_note: Use the unfilled v2.0 500 m full-domain mosaic. Do not switch to a filled DEM to rescue missing sites.

point_trait: nearest-valid-pixel elevation at the APBP site coordinate

coverage_gate.rule: At least 90% of the 122 candidate APBP sites must have at least one valid REMA pixel within the frozen 2 km primary radius.

boundary: REMA terrain is local topographic context, not occupied nesting habitat.
Terrain traits are not selected based on penguin outcomes.
The 2 km primary scale is inherited from the breeding-option atlas and is not retuned.
No demographic response is joined at this gate.

next_gate_only_if_passed.name: Gate 1D-B melt/climate augmentation
next_gate_only_if_passed.rule: Add melt/climate variables to the same frozen site set and 2 km primary scale before opening demographic outcomes.
